title: Before / after
summary: Two states of the same thing in one panel: the old one muted, a wipe, the new one in the brand's colors, then the close, in 16 s.

params.name: beforeLine
params.default: Forty minutes, three tools, one guess.
params.description: the old state, in one line

params.name: beforeImage
params.description: a picture of the old state (path)

params.name: afterLine
params.default: One command. Every frame on purpose.
params.description: the new state, in one line

params.name: afterImage
params.description: a picture of the new state (path)

params.name: action
params.description: the one action at the end

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

usage:
npx paper-motion add before-after --name my-piece
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-piece/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-piece/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work: pamo add sage-night instrument) and, for the background, a shader-set entry (pamo add mesh-sage).
A real picture of each state beats any panel; the before picture is shown desaturated.
Uses these moves from the engine: wipe, word-rise, blur-in, crossfade.

beats.name: Before
beats.what: the old state: muted panel, its line

beats.name: After
beats.what: the brand's state, the accent, its line

when: the product replaces a worse way
a redesign, a migration, a result
